name: Ai Content Writer : Seekahost
author: seekahost

sections.description:
Ai Content Writer : Seekahost is a powerful WordPress plugin that connects your website to the Ai Content Writer platform, allowing you to seamlessly publish AI-generated content directly to your WordPress site.

Key Features

  • Direct Publishing: Publish content from Ai Content Writer directly to your WordPress site
  • Category Management: Automatically create and assign categories
  • Featured Images: Support for featured images with automatic upload
  • SEO-Ready: Content is optimized for search engines
  • Secure Connection: Uses secure authentication and API endpoints

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Connect your WordPress site to your Ai Content Writer account
  3. Start creating content in Ai Content Writer
  4. Publish directly to your WordPress site with one click

Privacy Policy

This plugin connects your WordPress site to the Ai Content Writer platform. When you connect your site:

  • Your site URL and name are shared with Ai Content Writer
  • A secure token is stored in your WordPress database
  • No personal user data is collected or shared

For more information, visit our Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ai-content-writer-seekahost directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Ai Content Writer to configure the plugin
  4. Enter your Ai Content Writer Site URL and connect your account
sections.faq:
Do I need an Ai Content Writer account?

Yes, you need an active Ai Content Writer account to use this plugin. Visit Ai Content Writer to create an account.

Is the connection secure?

Yes, all communication between your WordPress site and Ai Content Writer is encrypted and secured using industry-standard protocols.

Can I disconnect my site?

Yes, you can easily disconnect your site at any time through the plugin settings page.
